country: The Republic of the Union of Myanmar
summary: Conservation pledges set an unconditional 25% net-emissions/deforestation reduction by 2030 and a conditional 50% reduction, while seeking to bring Reserved Forest/Protected Public Forest jurisdiction to 30% of national land and the Protected Areas System to 10% by 2030. Restoration centres on the MRRP: up to 251,000 ha of new forest, potentially 340,000 additional ha by 2030, and about 580,000 ha of plantations absorbing CO2 by 2030; detailed phases also target 331,251 ha of natural regeneration and 250,622 ha of new forest. Agriculture and cross-sector measures include tree-canopy enhancement and agroforestry on 275,000 ha—about 1.3% of current mapped agricultural land—with over 10.4 million tCO2e sequestration in 2021–2030, plus management of 0.25 million ha of plantations. The 251,000-ha new-forest aim equals roughly 0.7% of current mapped forest, and the 580,000-ha plantation total about 1.7%.
